name: Yancey
gaps: Parcels are OperationalLayers2025 TaxParcels (PRIMARY CAMA) (https://gis.yanceycountync.org/server/rest/services/OperationalLayers2025/MapServer/0). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Source query returned 4555 rows; 4517 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.
Pass 2 enrichment is from card pass2 (tax ok, sale ok). Pass 2 counted 152 NCDOT 2022 AADT stations. NCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.

Yancey STAMPS is excise tax, not a sale price, and is not stored as last-sale price. The property-appraiser pattern needs a two-digit card suffix the parcel layer does not publish, so parcel rows do not carry a filled appraiser URL.
This county is not on the rural Opportunity Zone pass-1 table. It fills the batch after Rutherford through Wilkes.
Non-OZ fill. Usable county parcel card; not on the rural Opportunity Zone pass-1 table.
Property-appraiser links are stored from the card or pass-2 pattern and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
